about: Mobic (meloxicam, an NSAID) is supplied four times from April to July 2026, shown by brand name only, and no proton pump inhibitor is supplied anywhere in the history.
Two short courses of Naprosyn (naproxen, an NSAID) are supplied on 13 January and 11 February 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, and no proton pump inhibitor is supplied anywhere.

Celebrex (celecoxib, an NSAID) is supplied from April to August 2026, but esomeprazole (Nexium, a proton pump inhibitor) is supplied every month from a week before the first NSAID supply, so nothing is omitted.
